Business expresses that relation and is not an unrelated supplied thing; it carries the content of the recast relational phrase under rules 24 and 49. The competing reading leaves business added and assigns only was to the preposition.

review_notes: Corrected: the second 'they should' is יִהְיוּ's distributed realization across the coordinated participles (rule 25), not the participle's; בָאִים keeps only 'come'.

review_notes: Variants v001 and v002 are underdetermined with the base reading retained; no FALLBACK EXCLUDED mark, so nothing is added or unrepresented on their account.

variant_decisions.evidence: Ketiv אשדודיות and qere אַשְׁדֳּדִיּוֹת differ only in orthography (plene vs. defective spelling of the same gentilic plural); ASV 'women of Ashdod' renders either identically. The only note on the verse is a hebrew_gloss on 'had married', not mapped to this unit. Base qere fallback retained.

Ketiv עמוניות and qere עַמֳּנִיּוֹת differ only in orthography (plene vs. defective spelling of the same gentilic plural); ASV 'of Ammon' renders either identically. The only note on the verse is a hebrew_gloss on 'had married', not mapped to this unit. Base qere fallback retained.
